text: Current focus of Salsabil Maulana Akbar (Sabil): AI/ML Engineer · Speech AI · NLP · Information Retrieval. Based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

AI/ML Engineer with 6 years of experience building production systems across Speech, NLP and Information Retrieval, Computer Vision, and Tabular ML. Experienced across the ML lifecycle, from research and experimentation to data pipelines, model optimization, deployment, and observability.
Production Systems: Built property valuation models, improved search relevance, and deployed multilingual speech models and scalable ML pipelines into production.
Experiment Design & Impact Measurement: Designed evaluation setups and measured the quantitative impact of model changes on relevance, conversion, and key business metrics at scale.
Generative AI & Voice: Currently researching, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying multilingual ASR and TTS models alongside training and benchmarking platforms for production voice systems.
Research: Published at EMNLP, ACL, and AACL on multilingual and low-resource NLP.
Interest and future direction (not past industry work), Trustworthy AI: Actively growing into Explainable AI and Causal Inference, working toward AI that is trustworthy and interpretable.

Keywords, domains, and tech stack for Sabil: Voice AI (current role): Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, NeMo, FastAPI, vLLM, Triton, NVIDIA NIM/Riva, LiveKit, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, DVC, GitHub Actions; Search & IR (Tokopedia, TikTok): Query understanding, graph embeddings, retrieval & ranking, vector databases, model distillation & quantization, TensorFlow, SQL, Airflow, GCP; Proptech (Pashouses): Tabular and geospatial modeling, computer vision, OCR, ETL pipelines, PostgreSQL, GCP; Mathematics & teaching: Applied mathematics, statistics, MATLAB, R.

Salsabil Maulana Akbar (Sabil) began his professional career in Nov 2020 (first role: Data Scientist at Pashouses). Compute his total years of experience from Nov 2020 to today's date. Roles in reverse-chronological order: ML Research Engineer at Stealth AI Startup (Oct 2024 - present); Algorithm Engineer at TikTok (Feb 2024 - Jul 2024); Data Scientist at Tokopedia (Sep 2021 - Jul 2024); Data Scientist at Pashouses (Nov 2020 - Sep 2021).

ML Research Engineer at Stealth AI Startup, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (Oct 2024 - present). Researched, fine-tuned, and deployed multilingual ASR and TTS models for production Speech AI across APAC and MENA languages, improving quality against strong open-source baselines. Built an internal speech-model benchmarking platform for hosted and local models across WER, CER, MOS, RTF, throughput, and GPU utilization. Evaluated and integrated denoising, LID, VAD, and turn detection into LiveKit-based voice systems. Built an internal speech-model training platform spanning data versioning, training, resource allocation, evaluation, and benchmarking; co-developed an LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline for multi-ASR auto-labeling and human-in-the-loop routing.

Algorithm Engineer at TikTok, Jakarta, Indonesia (Feb 2024 - Jul 2024). Harmonized search and retrieval systems across Tokopedia and TikTok Shop after the acquisition, adapting models to Indonesian marketplace data, taxonomy, and user behavior; developed a graph-embedding retrieval approach that improved search relevance and conversion. Migrated search use cases to TikTok's production ML platform, validating cross-platform data integrity and adapting workflows for automated training, embedding generation, vector-index updates, and retrieval indexing.

Data Scientist at Tokopedia, Jakarta, Indonesia (Sep 2021 - Jul 2024). Led Query Understanding for search personalization, combining query semantics and behavioral signals to model intent, attributes, and browse-versus-buy behavior, improving relevance, conversion, and transaction value. Co-developed a multi-label deep-learning query classifier over the product-category taxonomy for pre-retrieval and coarse-to-fine ranking. Optimized query classification for production through model distillation and quantization, reducing latency while retaining baseline performance and integrating with existing inference platforms.

Data Scientist at Pashouses, Jakarta, Indonesia (Nov 2020 - Sep 2021). Built and deployed an Automated Valuation Model for residential properties in Greater Jakarta, combining tabular and geospatial data with computer-vision-derived property-condition scores. Built computer-vision and data-processing workflows for property collection, including visual listing deduplication, OCR-based geolocation extraction, and automated ingestion and feature pipelines.

Bachelor of Science in Mathematics, Cum Laude, Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB) (Aug 2016 - Sep 2020). Thesis: Computational Fluid Dynamics of Wave Propagation using Shallow Water Equations. Relevant coursework: Computational Mathematics, Mathematical Optimization, Mathematical Statistics, Probability Theory.

Speaker at START Summit (Data Track), Tokopedia (Oct 2023). Prepared and delivered sessions on my work in search retrieval and product pre-filtering, titled "Enhancing User Search Experience using Query-Category Filtering".

Mentor & Instructor at Tokopedia (Aug 2022 - Nov 2022). Prepared and delivered an introduction to Natural Language Processing for the Tokopedia engineering team, as part of the Data Science and Engineering team's internal learning program.
Speaker at Institut Teknologi Kalimantan (Aug 2022). Gave a talk on career prospects in the data field from a mathematics perspective.
Instructor at Bitlabs Data Analytics for Business (Aug 2022 - Nov 2022). Taught elementary to intermediate SQL and Python to fresh graduates.

Instructor & Mentor, Machine Learning path at Bangkit Academy (Jan 2022 - May 2022). Taught Mathematics for Machine Learning and mentored cohorts on computer vision and NLP applications for their capstone projects.
Workshop instructor at Statistics Department, Universitas Padjadjaran (Nov 2018). Delivered a workshop on Statistics and Data Analysis with R.
Tutor at Various private institutions (self-employed) (Aug 2018 - May 2021). Tutored first and second year students across Business Mathematics, Calculus, Linear Algebra, and Statistics.

Laboratory assistant & tutor at Mathematics, ITB (Aug 2018 - Dec 2019). Assisted with solving math problems using software. Courses: Statistical Data Analysis, Data Visualization & Preprocessing, Mathematical Simulation & Computation, and Numerical Mathematics.

Teaching assistant at Electrical Engineering & Informatics, ITB (Feb 2018 - May 2018). Teaching assistant for the Introduction to Engineering & Design course, across both the School of Electrical Engineering & Informatics and the Faculty of Mathematics & Natural Sciences.
Online mentor at SUSBM Education (Aug 2016 - May 2017). Tutored Mathematics and Physics for the Indonesian university entrance test (SBMPTN).

Awards and honours won by Salsabil Maulana Akbar (Sabil): Best Resource Paper, NusaWrites (AACL, 2023); Top 1-3%, Telkomsel Indonesia Data Science Competition (Jakarta, Indonesia, 2021); Bronze Award, Regional Quant Challenge (WorldQuant, Jakarta, Indonesia, 2019).

Open-source projects by Sabil: ID ASR Dataset Generator (2023): v0 Indonesian ASR (automatic subtitle recognition) dataset built from news-channel videos; End-to-end ETL pipeline; langdetect-based subtitle cleansing (inspired by the C4 construction). ID NN-based Splitter (2023): Adapted wtpsplit (formerly NNSplit) to Indonesian data.

Academic interest, Bringing modern NLP to Indonesian & its local languages: LLMs underperform on low-resource languages due to scarce data; Many Indonesian local-language resources remain untapped by modern NLP; Contributing to projects (with talented collaborators across Indonesia) that address this gap.
Academic interest, Expanding generic NLP toolkits: Widely-used NLP toolkits often lack Indonesian and local-language support; Aiming to help democratize tooling and knowledge across languages.

Academic interest, Low-resource NLP research: Several Indonesian local languages are syntactically transferable from Indonesian without major semantic degradation; Dedicated to bridging NLP into low-resource languages via this approach; Aspiring to pursue a higher degree in an environment that enables driving this vision.

Other interests of Sabil: Cracking math problems; I still enjoy the challenge of proving or disproving a statement; Writing tidy, self-explainable code (self-taught, coming from a non-CS background); Truly end-to-end deployments built by hand (with a little help from Stack Overflow / ChatGPT); Finding the beauty of mathematics as a "language" for the real world, whether in DS, ML & AI, or the social sciences.
